title: Remove admin special signup password requirement and related UI messaging

requirements.text: Remove the special admin signup password requirement from the backend so that creating an admin account no longer requires providing a separate admin signup password.

quotes: want to remove admin special password requirement

acceptanceCriteria: Backend no longer traps/blocks admin signup due to an "incorrect signup password" check.
The backend does not require any additional password beyond normal authentication to create an admin account (admin eligibility should not depend on an extra signup password gate).
If the signupAdmin method remains exposed, it must not enforce a hardcoded adminSignupPassword check.

requirements.text: Remove any user-facing UI text and error messaging that states or implies admins require a special signup password (including: "Admin accounts require a special signup password. Contact your system administrator if you don't have it.").

quotes: Admin accounts require a special signup password. Contact your system administrator if you don't have it.
want to remove admin special password requirement

acceptanceCriteria: No screen, banner, form helper text, or error toast displays messaging that admins require a special signup password.
The signup error translation logic no longer returns a message indicating an "admin signup password is incorrect" (or equivalent), since the backend should not enforce that condition anymore.
Admin signup UX does not request a separate admin signup password field/step.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any path listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not change Internet Identity vs local-session authentication behavior beyond what is required to remove the admin special signup password requirement.
Do not change the admin allowlist/eligibility rules except as necessary to eliminate the special signup password gate.
Do not introduce new admin provisioning flows or new roles.
